script:
export const meta = {
  name: 'rapor-sayfalari',
  description: 'Turn the test-audit and event-pacing reports into two decision-first artifact pages',
  phases: [{ title: 'Pages', detail: 'one writer per report' }],
}
const SP = '/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-tugbauysal-Desktop-project-steam/6d15b35f-66f1-4e87-b274-dc8c31d2f7b4/scratchpad'
const TEMPLATE = '/Users/tugbauysal/Desktop/project steam/Project Unicorn/project-unicorn/docs/strateji/konusulacaklar/index.html'
const CONTRACT = `Page contract (Claude artifact): write page content directly, no doctype/html/head/body tags. First lines: <title>NAME</title>, then <meta name="claude:viewport-fit-sides" content="cover">, Google Fonts link, then <style>. Copy the template's :root tokens, dark-mode blocks (prefers-color-scheme guarded by :root:not([data-theme="light"]) and :root[data-theme="dark"]), body padding with max(16px, env(safe-area-inset-left/right)), and component classes (.box, .chip, .note, .src, table styles, .order, .flag, .run) from ${TEMPLATE}; reuse its fonts. Works at 400px width; wide tables inside an overflow-x:auto wrapper; no horizontal page scroll. No external images or scripts. No em dashes in prose. Turkish, plain short sentences, the owner is addressed as "sen" and is not a programmer: explain with what the player sees.`
const PAGES = [
  { key: 'test', title: 'Test Sistemi Denetimi', src: SP + '/test_denetimi_rapor.md', out: SP + '/sayfa_test/index.html',
    decisions: `Decisions block at the very top, each with options, the co-director's recommendation in one line, and why:
1. Yön: önce pilotla başlayalım mı? Önerim: evet. Pilot bir oturum (3–4 saat): olay fiili bağlantı denetimi + 3 oyuncu yolu testi; her test ilgili düzeltme geri alınınca kırmızıya dönmeli.
2. Eski kayıt göçleri: (a) demo öncesi eski kayıt desteği bırakılır, 21 vaka ve ölü kod gider, masaüstündeki eski playtest kayıtların açılmaz; (b) göçler kalır, tek gerçek kayıt dosyası vakasına iner. Önerim: (a), oyun henüz çıkmadı; dizüstündeki yeni kayıtların etkilenmez.
3. Tam paket ne zaman koşsun: (a) her "push et"te arka planda ~12 dk; (b) haftada bir ve her playtest'ten önce. Önerim: (b), push'un hızlı kalsın (6 Ekim kararın).
4. Commit'ten önce hızlı kontrol (2 dk altı) kendiliğinden koşsun mu? Önerim: pilot hızlı katmanın 2 dakikanın altında kaldığını kanıtlarsa evet.
5. Hazır test çatısı (gdUnit4) şimdilik yok; pilot zorlanırsa tek vakayla denensin. Önerim: evet, bu sırayla.` },
  { key: 'olay', title: 'Olay Sıklığı Araştırması', src: SP + '/olay_sikligi_rapor.md', out: SP + '/sayfa_olay/index.html',
    decisions: `Decisions block at the very top, each with options, the co-director's recommendation in one line, and why:
1. CLAUDE.md'deki kâğıt sıklığı cümlesi: (A) "%7–10" kural olsun; (B) ilke yazılsın, sayı tarihli ölçüm olarak dursun; (C) B'ye ek olarak mekanizma onarılsın. Önerim: B şimdi. Neden: incelenen 20'den fazla oyunun hiçbiri "turların %X'i" diye kural koymuyor; sayı kural olunca ajanlar onu tutturmak için zarla oynar.
2. Hiç gelmeyen 18 kâğıt (8 tasarımcı kâğıdının hiçbiri gelmiyor; gelenlerin %71'i yazılımcıdan): neden gelmediklerini bulan bir içerik onarımı iş listesine girsin mi? Önerim: evet, şimdi. Tekrar hissinin asıl kaynağı bu.
3. 1 haftada biten sprintin hiç kâğıt zarı görmemesi ve kâğıtlar arasında uzun sessizliği kapatan bir kuralın olmaması: playtest'ten sonra mı karar verelim? Önerim: evet, playtest'te iki şeye bak: kâğıtlar arası sessizlik uzun geliyor mu, kâğıtlar hep aynı kişiden mi geliyor.` },
]
phase('Pages')
const res = await parallel(PAGES.map(p => () => agent(`Turn the Turkish report ${p.src} into one artifact HTML page written to ${p.out} (create the folder). Title tag: "${p.title}".
${CONTRACT}
Structure: (1) eyebrow with date 28 Ekim 2026 and a one-paragraph answer; (2) ${p.decisions} Render this block first after the answer, in a highlighted box, numbered (numbers are real: they are the owner's decisions); (3) the report's content condensed: keep every table and every number, keep [S#] tags and the [GÖRÜŞ]/(varsayım)/[DEĞERLENDİREMEM] marks; turn long prose into short paragraphs and lists; (4) the source registry inside a <details> element at the bottom. Do not add facts that are not in the report. Do not drop any decision-relevant number. After writing, read your file once and fix broken HTML. Return the path and the number of tables and sources carried over.`, { label: `page:${p.key}`, phase: 'Pages' })))
return res
result:
The page is written at /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-tugbauysal-Desktop-project-steam/6d15b35f-66f1-4e87-b274-dc8c31d2f7b4/scratchpad/sayfa_test/index.html, with title "Test Sistemi Denetimi".

- **Tables carried over:** all 7, with every row kept: current system (9 rows), proposed layers (6), the 19 missed bugs by layer (6), smoke plan (12), token cost (7), migration plan (12 including "Sürekli"), and the source registry (37).
- **Sources carried over:** all 37 (S1–S37), in a collapsed `<details>` at the bottom. Each [S#] tag in the text links to its row, and a small inline script opens the `<details>` when one is clicked. The note about what could not be opened and the raw fetch output path are kept with the table.
- **Order:** eyebrow with 28 Ekim 2026 and a one-paragraph answer, then the 5 decisions in a highlighted numbered box (options, a one-line recommendation, and why), then the report sections 1–7, then the sources.
- **Marks:** all [GÖRÜŞ], (varsayım) and [DEĞERLENDİREMEM] marks are kept as small labels.
- **Checks:**
  - A tag-balance check found no broken HTML.
  - There are no em dashes. The report's "—" table cells became "yok".
  - Every in-page link has a target.
  - There are no doctype, html, head or body tags.

I added two things that are not in the report:
- **"Hayır" / "Şimdi geç" options.** Decisions 1, 4 and 5 each got a second option so they read as choices. The report only states the question.
- **The breakdown of the 21 cases in decision 2.** It reads "5 ölü göç vakası (~283 satır) + 16 eski kayıt vakası (~1.380 satır), ~235 satır ölü kod". These numbers come from the smoke plan table.

I did not check the 400px layout in a browser. Wide tables sit in horizontal-scroll wrappers, and the cards and stat tiles collapse to one column.

/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-tugbauysal-Desktop-project-steam/6d15b35f-66f1-4e87-b274-dc8c31d2f7b4/scratchpad/sayfa_olay/index.html

The page is written. It has 3 tables and all 74 sources (S1 to S74).

- **Tables (3):** the comparison table from §4.2 (11 rows, with a colored chip in the status column), external sources S1 to S63 (63 rows, URLs are links), and our code and docs S64 to S74 (11 rows). All three sit inside overflow-x:auto wrappers.
- **Sources (74):** 63 external and 11 internal. All of them are inside one `<details>` element at the bottom, along with the "Açılamayan sayfalar" and "Doğrulanmamış bilgi" lists and the S18 footnote. Each source row has an id (`s1` to `s74`).
- **Page order:**
  1. Eyebrow with 28 Ekim 2026, then a one-paragraph answer.
  2. The three decisions in a highlighted box, numbered 1 to 3. Each has its options, "Önerim" and "Neden".
  3. A row of six number tiles.
  4. The report's §2 to §5. Every number, every [S#] tag and every [GÖRÜŞ], (varsayım) and [DEĞERLENDİREMEM] mark is kept.
  5. The source registry.
- **Checks:** I read the file back after writing it. A tag-balance parse found no errors and no unclosed tags. There is no em dash in the prose. The only one on the page is inside the real filename in the S69 row, `GDDs/GDD — OLAY MOTORU (EVENT ENGINE) rev 2.md`, which I kept exact.
- **Other contract items:**
  - The title tag is "Olay Sıklığı Araştırması".
  - The `:root` and dark-mode tokens, safe-area body padding, fonts and component classes are copied from konusulacaklar.
  - Two template rules are scoped to `.order > li` so lists nested inside the decisions are not numbered too.
  - There are no external images or scripts.

The page is a local file and has not been published.
